title: Task gaps
description: One repository's task gaps file (<work>/tasks-<slug>.gaps.json), handed to its task decomposer as `task gaps` with its Tasks file when the decomposer's Tasks leave something the Story builds uncited, a Task unsized, or no Task at all; the decomposer corrects each gap. The step `task_decomposition.plan` (orchestrator/flows/task_decomposition.py) writes it and validates it against this file. It names items and Tasks by id and copies neither: each item is in the `items` of the repository context the decomposer already holds (`repository context`, spec-context.schema.json), and each Task is in its Tasks file.

uncited.description: The `id` of each item of the repository context's `items` that no Task cites in its `requirementIds`, in the order of `items`.

unsized.description: The `key` of each Task in the Tasks file that carries no size.

empty.description: True when the Tasks file holds no Task.
